<thought>Generate a list of 40 oxide compositions, retrieve up to 3 polymorphs per composition within 0.3 eV/atom above the hull, consolidate the resulting JSON files into a single dataset, and return the path to the consolidated JSON file.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
    "compositions": [
        "TiO2","Fe2O3","Al2O3","SiO2","ZnO","CuO","NiO","CoO","MnO2","Cr2O3",
        "MgO","CaO","Na2O","K2O","SnO2","PbO","Bi2O3","V2O5","MoO3","WO3",
        "ZrO2","HfO2","Ga2O3","In2O3","CdO","GeO2","Sb2O3","Ti2O3","FeO",
        "Cu2O","Ag2O","Au2O3","B2O3","P2O5","SiO","TiO","Fe3O4","Co3O4",
        "Mn3O4","PbO2"
    ],
    "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
    "max_per_composition": 3,
    "save_directory": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/0_batch_retrieve_oxide_polymorphs_trial_1/oxide_polymorphs"
}
</action_input>
